SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
RECRUITMENT OF JUNIOR COURT ASSISTANT
Online applications from eligible candidates are invited for the post of
Junior Court Assistant (Group 'B' , Non- Gazetted Post) placed in Level 6 of
Pay Matrix with initial Basic Pay of Rs. 35,400/-. The approximate Gross
Salary as per existing rate of allowance including I-IRA comes to Rs. 72,040/-
per month (pre-revised pay scale PB-2 with Grade Pay of Rs. 4200/-). The
details about eligibility conditions etc. can be downloaded from Supreme Court
Website www.sci.gov.in.
